entries.root_cause: Monitoring-source row creation was coupled to a privileged AFTER INSERT bootstrap that granted volatile host-inventory runtime admission. Logical restore, relocation, COPY, or replay can legitimately recreate source rows through INSERT, so object existence incorrectly became sufficient evidence of current recovery and placement authority.
horizontal_audit: monitoring source creation versus runtime admission
future provider source bootstrap side effects

entries.root_cause: The host-inventory resource projection protected state and poll-authority fields but omitted provider-derived observation timestamps from the guarded mutation set. A same-tenant direct writer could therefore forge freshness or regress durable observation chronology without accepted provider evidence.

The runtime-admission table was made UNLOGGED to fail closed across physical recovery, but logical backup semantics were not separately governed. PostgreSQL logical dumps include unlogged-table rows by default, so stale placement and recovery admission could cross a dump/restore boundary and regain current polling authority without successor-epoch re-admission.
horizontal_audit: physical recovery versus logical recovery semantics
all ephemeral authority state that must not cross logical copies

entries.root_cause: Host-inventory conformance was split across migration-era harnesses, allowing green evidence from historical schemas to be interpreted as assurance for the composed exact-head schema. Later executor, recovery-epoch and projection-authority migrations could therefore regress previously proven behavior without those scenarios being replayed against the schema actually shipped.
horizontal_audit: logical recovery and authority projection guards

entries.root_cause: Host-inventory operation authority was guarded only on UPDATE. Because the modeled tenant runtime can INSERT monitoring_sync_operation rows, it could manufacture an operation already in running/claimed state with the source's current poll epoch and generation, bypassing the guarded claim transition and reusing current-state authority.
horizontal_audit: public completion entry points that trust claimed-operation rows
